title: Subtraction is not comparison
hints: a.Balance - b.Balance looks like a comparison result, but for large values the subtraction overflows int64 and wraps around to the opposite sign.
cmp.Compare(x, y) returns -1, 0 or +1 without doing any arithmetic, so it can't overflow.
slices.SortFunc(accts, func(a, b Account) int { return cmp.Compare(b.Balance, a.Balance) })  — note b before a for largest first.
